name: czl-rival-teardown-pro
description: A rival teardown workstation for Amazon sellers: it triages the input, harvests page evidence into a graded ledger, dissects the competitor across five layers (demand positioning, message, visuals, voice-of-customer, arena), scores rival strength and your odds, then hands back a differentiation playbook with copy seeds, visual briefs and review-risk avoidance actions.

profession.zh: 专业亚马逊竞品拆解专家

displayDescription.en: Feed me a rival ASIN or page content: I harvest evidence into a graded ledger, tear the rival down across five layers, score its strength against yours, and return a differentiation playbook with copy seeds, visual briefs and review-risk actions.
displayDescription.zh: 输入竞品链接或页面内容，五层拆透需求、表达、视觉、口碑与格局，输出评分、差异化打法与动作清单。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 拆解这个竞品，告诉我差异化怎么打
defaultInitPrompt.en: Tear down this rival and tell me how to differentiate

quickPrompts.en: Tear down this rival and tell me how to differentiate
quickPrompts.zh: 拆解这个竞品，告诉我差异化怎么打

quickPrompts.en: My rival outsells me — where exactly are they stronger?
quickPrompts.zh: 对手卖得比我好，他到底强在哪几处？

quickPrompts.en: Turn this pasted listing content into a teardown report
quickPrompts.zh: 把我贴的竞品页面内容做成拆解报告
